issues.reason: The half that stands is that no genitive marks 'Los Angeles Mayor' and the office's jurisdiction argument is lost; the half that falls is the charge of falsehood — Possession is declared opaque and 'covers ownership, kinship, and looser association alike without having to mean ownership', so the atom is true of the sentence in gap territory and has no licensed replacement, only deletion, which would lose a stated link.

'(Ongoing e) needs an explicit marker — there are exactly four', and a bare participial post-modifier on a noun (a reduced relative, with no is/was V-ing auxiliary and no perception matrix) is none of them, so the atom violates a rule the instruction set states.

gaps_confirmed: pre-nominal office title carrying its own place argument ('Los Angeles Mayor Richard Riordan'): the title rule covers only kinship/courtesy titles and offers no way to attach the jurisdiction to the office
privative / temporal 'former' before a role noun: no rule, so the parse approximates it with a Past wrapper
tense/aspect inheritance for a reduced relative clause: fixed only for appositives, which take the host clause's wrapper
new_gaps: a restrictive participial modifier that defines a group's extension ('those awaiting X'): the parse must assert the restriction as an independent fact about the group, since nothing licenses recording it as the group's membership condition
repair_summary: Removed (Ongoing sk_await_1), which no licensed progressive marker supports; every other atom, symbol name and line order is unchanged.
notes: (Past sk_await_1) is left standing — the reduced relative's tense inheritance is a registered gap and the host clause is past, so the wrapper is not part of the confirmed issue.
